name: Fluo-N2DL-HeLa/01
title: Fluorescent HeLa nuclei
about: A development video (sequence 01). The model marked the cells in the first frame, then said where each one was every 10 frames, and each division was narrowed down to one frame. The rings are its marks: only they train the tracker, and the line between them is drawn for the eye. The reference tracks are shown for comparison only: no part of the labelling read them.

names.agent: The model's marks, joined by straight lines (only the marks are training labels)
names.ref: Reference track of the same cell (not used for training)
